score_breakdown.category: Protected source, layout, scale and interfaces

evidence.probe_method: Three fresh disposable Blender processes. First ran the current verifier with --cold after intercepting Path.write_text in memory so no existing report was overwritten, then independently inspected UV defaults and named print consumers, live material branches, hierarchy, dependencies and recorded cameras. Second independently sampled support vertices, edge midpoints and polygon centroids, scanned exact visible raw-mesh duplicates and reconstructed corner hidden sets and orthographic fits. Third inspected active texture-coordinate branches and floor users. No native source save, rebuild, or render was executed.

pixel_review.purpose: Technical corroboration of separation, contact, print orientation, camera framing and intentional cutaways; no visual score awarded.

protected_boundary.intentional_pose_exceptions: 49 clipboard and reserve service-door/detail objects listed by build-state; not room boundaries or major equipment relocation.
protected_boundary.notes: Baseline matrices and dimensions were compared for all inherited objects. Major interfaces and utility placement remain inherited. METRIC units, scale_length1.0.

winding.notes: Evaluated revised and additive meshes were checked. Open print surfaces are intentional; no claim of a full-room manifold or self-intersection census.

duplicate_geometry.method: Matching world vertex coordinates rounded to7 decimal places, face order and material slots. Does not detect arbitrary partial overlaps or all evaluated modifier intersections.

uv.notes: MED_Physical_1m is local dominant-normal-axis projection multiplied by object scale; intentional tiled overlap and out-of-range coordinates are allowed. It is not a unique lightmap or an isometric unwrap.

material_branches.physical_branch: Four controlled_finish materials (ivory instrument enamel, treatment vinyl, cotton and carton) use MED_Physical_1m -> Noise scale180 -> Bump Strength0.055/Distance0.00015m. Color and roughness use med_contact_wear attributes.
material_branches.retained_branch: Retained/reference graphs also use explicit Object/Geometry mappings and implicit Generated vectors. Broad procedural variation and the slate-fabric wave are not globally physical-UV scaled.
material_branches.main_floor_branch: Generated -> Multiply(8.36,9.36,0.24) -> Brick Width/Row Height0.60m, matching the main Floor bounds.
material_branches.decon_floor_qualification: Same graph is also assigned to Decon floor(2.06x2.12x0.24m), so the tile repeat there is approximately148x136mm rather than600mm. Grating largely obscures this small area.
material_branches.print_images: Packed sRGB clinical-labels.png1024x1024 and clinical-propaganda.png1024x1536; images are live base-color consumers. No tangent normal image -> Bump error observed.

noncritical_findings.finding: These inherited users of the new carton material lack its requested MED_Physical_1m layer.
noncritical_findings.impact: Tiny UV-driven microheight is unavailable/degenerate on three under-bench cartons; base color and modeled/printed construction are unaffected.
noncritical_findings.recommendation: In a future authorized source pass, extend named-UV coverage to all active material users, or give these users a material without the physical microheight branch.

noncritical_findings.impact: Bounded material scale discrepancy beneath drain grating, no protected layout or contact failure.
noncritical_findings.recommendation: Qualify the documentation now; use per-object physical coordinates or a separate decon material only in a future source pass.

limitations: Fresh source open and current objective checks were executed; a destructive full rebuild was deliberately outside this read-only critic pass.
No fresh pixel render or cold RGB equivalence comparison was performed by this critic. Parent's final cold comparison remains a separate acceptance gate.
Normal coverage is the156 revised/additive meshes. Exact duplicate scan does not establish absence of every partial overlap, self-intersection or inherited topology issue.

Most compound support groups use one frozen witness, while the ten sewn groups and two battery labels have wider geometric coverage. Surface sampling is finite and does not mathematically prove every triangle interior.
No unique-lightmap, mip-padding, bake, export conversion, runtime collision, performance, animation sweep or Unity validation is claimed.
The source remains unchanged; score and pass apply only to native ef097c0052c95bf23c8a4d542db661cb151566f8618c287931f4ffa163015ff7 and recorded cycle10 evidence.
